correctness.rationale: For every high-radius edge attaining the B tail, a finite-support distance-to-edge tent of height r-ceil(sqrt(r)) has norm one, equal height at the edge endpoints and gradients vanishing eventually at each fixed edge. Hahn–Banach extension to the edge-coordinate c0 predual proves weak convergence in the little space, and inclusion transfers it to the big space. Every compact perturbation has norm-null action, so the product edge difference yields essential norm >= B. Point indicators similarly yield >= A. The independently inspected arXiv:2602.13534v1 Proposition 8.3 establishes <=4A+B on both spaces, giving exact B when A=0. All quantifiers, local finiteness, boundary cases B=0 and orientation differences are addressed in RESULT.md. A finite ladder checker passed 103 assertions; infinity follows from proof, not the checker.
